PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached or run, and no upstream simulator, gym or MuJoCo run is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper MujocoDriver (mujoco family), but the confirmed entry symbol gym_mimic_envs.mujoco.mimic_walker3d:MimicWalker3dEnv is a Gym environment (MimicEnv(MujocoEnv, EzPickle)), not a raw MJCF model. A MujocoDriver would expose only qpos/qvel/ctrl and would drop the environment's reward, 29-value phase observation and terminal semantics, so the package is a GymnasiumDriver over the environment-step interface (cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.seed.v1). The simulated family-config decision and R0 mode are unchanged.

ENTRY AND RUNTIME: MimicWalker3dEnv is confirmed at mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mujoco/mimic_walker3d.py:31 and is concrete; it implements the base hooks at :59-84 and registers as MimicWalker3d-v0 at mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/__init__.py:8-10. Only the fake backend factory exists (backends = {"fake": ".fake:FakeMimicWalker3dEnv"}); a backend name not in backends would call gym.make(env_id), which cannot run at this pin. The upstream environment cannot be constructed at commit 09d3bbd64a6b2fdd538b1d4465001bb1914243de: mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mujoco/__init__.py:1 imports the absent mimic_walker2d.py; scripts/config_light.py:28 names walker3d_flat_feet_lowmass.xml, which is absent from mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mujoco/assets/ (only walker3d_flat_feet.xml is there); scripts/mocap/ref_trajecs.py:26-35 loads reference trajectories from hard-coded absolute paths outside the clone; and gym, mujoco-py and MuJoCo 2.1 are not installed where the gate runs. No install was attempted, and repairing those files would require writing into the read-only clone. The real/sim path therefore needs upstream repairs plus gym, mujoco-py, MuJoCo 2.1 and the mocap data; it was not run and no runtime construction is claimed.

FAKE: an analytic F0 stand-in, not a recording and not MuJoCo. It models a synthetic 8-joint gait, the configured reward weights and alive bonus, the 29-value observation layout and the upstream terminal thresholds, but no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors or noise; every invented gait/state/reward number is marked # placeholder in fake.py. The action bound shown in reference.json is the only pinned MJCF asset's default ctrlrange -300..300 (mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mujoco/assets/walker3d_flat_feet.xml:8), which gym's MujocoEnv copies into the inherited action space; the configured lowmass model is missing, so that model's actual ctrlrange is unknown and this is a fake limitation, not a device fact. MimicEnv itself clips the policy action to [-1,1] before scaling (mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mimic_env.py:161), and the fake does the same. One tick is the 5 ms control period (SIM_FREQ 1000 Hz / CTRL_FREQ 200 Hz, config_light.py:30-32 and mimic_env.py:57-60). The observation is 29 floats: phase, desired speed, 13 qpos values and 14 qvel values (mimic_env.py:351-388).

WARNINGS kept from the last gate run (none failed): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the pending seed of the next reset, so no native call is made); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x3 for action_space, observation_space and reset, which the external gym MujocoEnv/Env base provides (MimicEnv's base is outside the clone); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs seed (reset), seed (seed class), ticks and action.values. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds nine cases: control-range envelope, seeded reset and deterministic repeat, seed class, one 5 ms tick and the 29-value observation, action effect, early termination, walking-distance termination, published fidelity, and the software e-stop latch. They pass.

NOT COVERED: the real MimicWalker3dEnv construction and any gym/MuJoCo execution; rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators and the reference-trajectory data; the upstream imitation reward; rendering; snapshot/restore (the class exposes no get_state/set_state pair); wall-clock pacing; and any physical device. No catalogue_requests are needed (only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1) and there is no site-limits.example.json (no operator-required bound). The fake returns Python floats and lists where upstream returns numpy arrays. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
